verdict.rationale: Caveman's own site documents an official, open-source Caveman CLI that wraps supported coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) and works without a cloud account. The evidence is limited to two short marketing statements. missing for 10: command reference or install/usage documentation, details of the CLI's subcommands and agent-facing workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI itself

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The open-source Caveman CLI wraps supported agents including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
The open-source CLI, shorter replies and context compression work without one.
